findings.detail: The Safari section cut every limitation attached to `extension dev --browser=safari`. English says it "runs on macOS only, needs the full Xcode app, and has no live reload yet, so every size tweak means another build (see [Safari](/docs/browsers/safari))"; the translation had only "并用 `extension dev --browser=safari` 测试". A non-macOS reader is sent to a command that cannot run on their platform, a reader without Xcode hits an unexplained failure, and anyone iterating on popup CSS expects live reload that does not exist. Restored all three limitations plus the cross-link, using the localized link text (构建 Safari 扩展) that the rest of the zh-Hans docs already use for that page.

Identical omission to the zh-Hans twin: the macOS-only restriction, the full-Xcode requirement, the no-live-reload limitation and the rebuild-per-tweak consequence were all dropped, along with the [Safari](/docs/browsers/safari) link. Restored with the localized link text (建置 Safari 擴充功能) used elsewhere in zh-Hant.

"outside the watcher's view" was rendered 监听器视野之外. In these docs 监听器 consistently means an event listener (background.mdx, reload-and-hmr.mdx, trigger-actions-and-commands.mdx), which is a different concept from the file watcher meant here; the file watcher is 文件监听/监视器 elsewhere (environment-variables.mdx, lifecycle-stream.mdx). Changed to 文件监视器. The zh-Hant twin already had this right (監看器).

English: "Static themes are exempt from all dev instrumentation." The Chinese read 靜態佈景主題完全不受任何開發期插樁影響 ("static themes are completely unaffected by any dev instrumentation"), which implies the instrumentation is still applied but has no effect. The whole point of the section, and of the following sentence about injected keys breaking theme-schema validation, is that the instrumentation is never applied at all. Repaired to 靜態佈景主題完全不套用任何開發期插樁, which also lines up with the section heading 略過開發期插樁. The zh-Hans twin (不接受任何开发期插桩) was already correct and was left alone.

English: "When you build for `safari` or a webkit-based target". The Chinese read 某个 webkit 目标 ("some webkit target"), which loses the fact that webkit-based is the concrete engine-alias build target, and diverges from the term the rest of the translated corpus already uses (zh-Hans/docs/features/browser-specific-fields.mdx: webkit 系目标). Repaired to webkit 系目标.

Same defect as the zh-Hans twin: 某個 webkit 目標 for English "a webkit-based target", losing the engine-alias sense and diverging from zh-Hant/docs/features/browser-specific-fields.mdx which uses webkit 系目標. Repaired to webkit 系目標.

Line 87 rendered the English "Reading is always free." as "读取始终是免费开放的。" — 免费 means free of charge, which invents a pricing claim the English does not make. The sentence is about read tools needing no per-session unlock, contrasted with the next sentence's opt-in state changes. Repaired to "读取始终不需要解锁。"
Line 87 rendered "Reading is always free." as "讀取一律免費開放。" — 免費 reads as free of charge rather than requiring no unlock, a claim absent from the English. Repaired to "讀取一律不需要解鎖。"

The entire page used halfwidth ASCII punctuation after Chinese text (44 commas, 12 colons, 1 semicolon, 1 paren pair) where every other zh-Hant page on the site, and its own zh-Hans twin, use fullwidth ，：；（）. Example: line 2 title '工作階段產物:Extension.js…' and line 20 '寫到磁碟上:機器可讀的契約、記錄、一條控制通道,以及…'. Fixed in place: converted to fullwidth everywhere outside the ```text fence, markdown link targets, inline code spans, and the YAML frontmatter keys (title:/description: deliberately left as ASCII so the frontmatter still parses). Verified afterwards that all code spans, fences, links and headings are still byte-identical to the English page.

Lead sentence rendered English 'instead of scraping log lines' as '而不是去刮終端機記錄' (scraping terminal records), which shifts the object from log lines to the terminal and adds a claim the English does not make. The page is specifically about parsing logs.ndjson-style log lines, not terminal scrollback. Changed to '而不是去刮取記錄行。', matching the zh-Hans twin's '刮取日志行'.

Five outbound markdown links to docs.extension.dev lost the sponsor UTM query string that the English page carries (intro link, the two 'Share an unpublished build for review' links, 'Access tokens', 'the platform's publish page', and 'Builds'). Other translated pages in this repo (zh-Hans/docs/commands/build.mdx, zh-Hans/docs/getting-started/index.mdx, zh-Hans/docs/browsers/safari.mdx) preserve the UTM params, so this is drift from both the English source and the established convention. Restored ?utm_source=extension-js-org&utm_medium=sponsor&utm_campaign=docs-seam on all six markdown links, leaving the bare URL inside the plaintext error-output code fence untouched because English has no UTM there either.

Same defect as the zh-Hans twin: the sponsor UTM query string was stripped from the outbound docs.extension.dev markdown links (intro, both 'Share an unpublished build for review' links, 'Access tokens', the platform publish page, and 'Builds'). Restored ?utm_source=extension-js-org&utm_medium=sponsor&utm_campaign=docs-seam on all six, leaving the URL inside the plaintext code fence byte-identical to English.
